name: cemainou
description: Your team's work log, written by the AI agents you already use: measures each Claude Code session's time, links it to its project, brings the team's context in, and drafts the daily update with /upd. Connects to your own self-hosted cemainou.

server_url.title: cemainou address
server_url.description: Your team's cemainou, for example https://cemainou.example.com (without /mcp).

api_key.title: Agent key
api_key.description: In cemainou: Profile, Agents, Connect an agent, Other. Copy the key; it is shown once.

only_folders.title: Only these folders (optional)
only_folders.description: Only sessions started inside these folders reach cemainou, separated by colons, for example /home/ana/clients:/home/ana/work. Empty: every folder.
